words.defn_en: ruin:

sentences.en: The hurricane wreaked ______ on the small coastal town.
sentences.zh: 這場颶風對這座沿海小鎮造成了嚴重的破壞。

sentences.en: A single computer virus can wreak ______ across an entire network.
sentences.zh: 一個電腦病毒就能對整個網路系統造成巨大的破壞。

words.defn_en: the act of giving something up completely; the state of being deserted:

sentences.en: The old lighthouse showed years of ______ , its windows shattered and its door hanging open.
sentences.zh: 那座舊燈塔顯露出多年遭遺棄的痕跡,窗戶破碎,大門敞開。

sentences.en: Her sudden ______ of the project left the whole team scrambling to finish it on time.
sentences.zh: 她突然放棄這個計畫,讓整個團隊手忙腳亂地想辦法準時完成。

words.defn_en: to become less active, intense, or great:

sentences.en: As I began my speech, my feelings of nervousness quickly ______.
sentences.zh: 我開始演講時,緊張的情緒很快就減弱消退了。

sentences.en: The storm is expected to ______ by early morning.
sentences.zh: 預計這場暴風雨將在清晨前逐漸減弱。

words.defn_en: a slaughterhouse:

sentences.en: The documentary followed a truckload of cattle from the farm to the ______.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片跟拍一車牛隻,從農場一路到屠宰場。

sentences.en: Local residents complained about the smell drifting from the ______ down the road.
sentences.zh: 當地居民抱怨從路那頭的屠宰場飄來的氣味。

words.defn_en: arranged alphabetically; a person learning the alphabet or basics of a subject:
words.defn_zh: 按字母順序排列的;初學者
words.root_note: abecedarius (from the letters a, b, c, d)

sentences.en: The teacher handed out an ______ list of vocabulary words for the beginners.
sentences.zh: 老師發給初學者一份按字母順序排列的單字表。

sentences.en: As an ______ in coding, he struggled with even the simplest commands.
sentences.zh: 身為程式設計的初學者,他連最簡單的指令都感到吃力。

words.defn_en: to aid, help, encourage:

sentences.en: The getaway driver was charged with helping to ______ the robbery.
sentences.zh: 這名接應逃跑的司機被控協助教唆這起搶案。

sentences.en: She refused to ______ her friend's plan to skip school.
sentences.zh: 她拒絕協助朋友蹺課的計畫。

words.defn_en: to put up with:

sentences.en: All members must ______ by the club's strict code of conduct.
sentences.zh: 所有會員都必須遵守這個社團嚴格的行為準則。

sentences.en: I cannot ______ people who are constantly late for meetings.
sentences.zh: 我無法忍受開會總是遲到的人。

words.defn_en: burning fiercely; brightly lit or full of strong emotion:

sentences.en: Within minutes the dry brush was ______ , sending smoke high into the sky.
sentences.zh: 短短幾分鐘,乾燥的灌木叢就熊熊燃燒起來,濃煙直衝天際。

sentences.en: Her eyes were ______ with excitement when she opened the acceptance letter.
sentences.zh: 打開錄取信的那一刻,她的眼睛因興奮而閃閃發亮。

words.defn_en: having the power, skill, or means to do something; competent:

sentences.en: Despite the language barrier, she proved ______ to lead the entire negotiation.
sentences.zh: 儘管有語言隔閡,她仍證明自己有能力主導整場談判。

sentences.en: The company looks for candidates who are ______ to work independently under pressure.
sentences.zh: 這家公司尋找能在壓力下獨立工作的人才。

words.defn_en: an abnormal fear of washing or bathing:

sentences.en: The toddler's tantrums at bath time were extreme enough that his mother wondered about mild ______.
sentences.zh: 小男孩洗澡時鬧得特別兇,媽媽甚至懷疑他有輕微的洗浴恐懼症。

sentences.en: Severe ______ can make even routine hygiene feel like an ordeal.
sentences.zh: 嚴重的洗浴恐懼症會讓連基本的清潔都變成一場煎熬。

words.defn_en: a place where one lives; a home or dwelling:

sentences.en: After years of traveling, he finally found a permanent ______ in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 經過多年的漂泊,他終於在鄉間找到了永久的住所。

sentences.en: The old castle has been the family's ______ for over three centuries.
sentences.zh: 這座古堡三百多年來一直是這個家族的住所。

words.defn_en: honest and open; without any attempt at deception:
words.root_note: above + board (table, i.e. not hiding cards under the table)

sentences.en: The auditor confirmed that every transaction had been completely ______.
sentences.zh: 審計人員確認每一筆交易都完全光明正大。

sentences.en: She insisted on keeping the negotiations ______ , with no secret side deals.
sentences.zh: 她堅持整個談判過程要光明正大,不搞任何私下的秘密協議。

words.defn_en: side by side and facing the same way; up to date with:

sentences.en: The two cyclists rode ______ , chatting easily despite the steep climb.
sentences.zh: 兩位騎士並肩騎行,儘管爬坡陡峭仍談笑自若。

sentences.en: She reads industry journals every week to stay ______ of new regulations.
sentences.zh: 她每週閱讀業界期刊,以隨時掌握最新法規。

words.defn_en: shorten

sentences.en: The publisher decided to ______ the novel for younger readers.
sentences.zh: 出版社決定為年輕讀者刪節這部小說。

sentences.en: The lecture had to be ______d due to time constraints.
sentences.zh: 由於時間有限,這場演講不得不被縮短。

words.defn_en: a large quantity of something; more than enough:

sentences.en: The region is known for its ______ of natural resources.
sentences.zh: 這個地區以其豐富的天然資源而聞名。

sentences.en: There was an ______ of fresh fruit at the market this summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天市場上有豐富的新鮮水果。

words.defn_en: existing or available in large quantities:

sentences.en: The region is known for its ______ natural resources.
sentences.zh: 這個地區以豐富的天然資源聞名。

sentences.en: Rainfall was especially ______ this year, filling the reservoirs.
sentences.zh: 今年降雨特別豐沛,使水庫蓄水充足。

words.defn_en: extremely bad:

sentences.en: I got an ______ grade on my research paper!
sentences.zh: 我的研究報告拿到了一個糟糕透頂的成績!

sentences.en: The team's performance this season has been simply ______.
sentences.zh: 這支球隊本季的表現簡直糟糕透頂。

words.defn_en: the environment or community of scholars and researchers:

sentences.en: After years in ______ , she left the university to start her own company.
sentences.zh: 在學術界待了多年後,她離開大學創辦了自己的公司。

sentences.en: Debate over the new theory has consumed ______ for the past decade.
sentences.zh: 這項新理論的爭論已讓學術界爭吵了十年之久。

words.defn_en: satisfactory or permissible:

sentences.en: The teacher deemed Sara's late assignment ______.
sentences.zh: 老師認為莎拉遲交的作業是可以接受的。

sentences.en: It is not ______ to speak to customers in that manner.
sentences.zh: 用那種方式跟顧客說話是不可接受的。

words.defn_en: happening by chance:

sentences.en: The oil spill was purely ______.
sentences.zh: 這起漏油事件純屬意外。

sentences.en: Their meeting at the conference was completely ______.
sentences.zh: 他們在會議上的相遇完全是偶然的。

words.defn_en: a male midwife or obstetrician:
words.root_note: accoucher (to assist at childbirth, from French)

sentences.en: In eighteenth-century France, a fashionable ______ might attend the births of noble families.
sentences.zh: 在十八世紀的法國,一位時髦的男助產士可能會為貴族家庭接生。

sentences.en: The novel's plot hinges on a scandal involving the village ______.
sentences.zh: 這部小說的情節,圍繞著村裡那位男助產士引發的醜聞展開。

words.defn_en: the quality of being correct or precise:

sentences.en: The ______ of the intern's report was impressive.
sentences.zh: 這位實習生報告的準確性令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: Scientists strive for the highest possible ______ in their measurements.
sentences.zh: 科學家們致力於在測量中達到最高的準確度。

words.defn_en: biting, bitter in tone or taste:

sentences.en: The critic was known for his ______ reviews of new restaurants.
sentences.zh: 這位評論家以對新餐廳撰寫尖酸刻薄的評論而聞名。

sentences.en: Her ______ wit often left her opponents speechless.
sentences.zh: 她尖酸的機智言辭經常讓對手啞口無言。

words.defn_en: sharpness or bitterness of tone, temper, or expression:

sentences.en: The critic reviewed the film with characteristic ______ , calling it "a waste of celluloid."
sentences.zh: 這位影評人一如既往地尖酸刻薄,批評這部電影「浪費了膠捲」。

sentences.en: Years of disappointment had left a trace of ______ in her voice.
sentences.zh: 多年的失望在她的語氣中留下了一絲刻薄。

words.defn_en: having the properties of an acid; sharply critical:

sentences.en: The lake's ______ water killed off most of the native fish population.
sentences.zh: 湖水的酸性殺死了大部分原生魚類。

sentences.en: His ______ comments about her cooking ruined the whole dinner party.
sentences.zh: 他對她廚藝尖酸刻薄的評論,毀了整場晚宴。

words.defn_en: somewhat sour in taste or manner; sharp-tongued:

sentences.en: The lemonade had an ______ tang that made her pucker.
sentences.zh: 這杯檸檬水帶著微酸的味道,讓她皺起了臉。

sentences.en: His ______ wit made him a feared guest at dinner parties.
sentences.zh: 他尖酸刻薄的機智,讓他成為晚宴上令人生畏的賓客。

words.defn_en: relating to the acme, or highest point, of development:

sentences.en: Historians consider the third century to be the empire's ______ period.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家認為第三世紀是這個帝國的鼎盛時期。

sentences.en: The coach believes the team is entering its ______ phase this season.
sentences.zh: 教練認為球隊本季正邁入巔峰狀態。

words.defn_en: peak, pinnacle, zenith:

sentences.en: Winning the gold medal represented the ______ of her athletic career.
sentences.zh: 贏得金牌代表了她運動生涯的頂峰。

sentences.en: The company reached the ______ of its success before the market crashed.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在市場崩盤前達到了成功的巔峰。

words.defn_en: a person assisting a priest in a religious service; a devoted follower:

sentences.en: As a young ______ , he lit the candles before every Sunday mass.
sentences.zh: 年少時,他擔任助祭,每個週日彌撒前負責點燃蠟燭。

sentences.en: The professor was surrounded by ______ eager to hear his every theory.
sentences.zh: 這位教授身邊圍繞著渴望聆聽他每個理論的追隨者。

words.defn_en: an imaginary ringing or buzzing sound in the ear:

sentences.en: After the concert, he experienced a strange ______ that lasted for hours.
sentences.zh: 音樂會結束後,他經歷了一種奇怪的耳鳴幻覺,持續了好幾個小時。

sentences.en: The patient described the ______ as a faint, high-pitched whine.
sentences.zh: 病人形容那種幻聽聲響是一種微弱、高頻的嗡嗡聲。

words.defn_en: relating to sound or the sense of hearing; not electronically amplified:

sentences.en: The concert hall was praised for its excellent ______ design.
sentences.zh: 這座音樂廳因出色的聲學設計而備受讚譽。

sentences.en: The band surprised fans with a stripped-down, ______ version of their hit song.
sentences.zh: 樂團以精簡的原聲版本演奏他們的熱門歌曲,讓歌迷驚喜不已。

words.defn_en: the quality of sound, pertaining to how it is heard based on the quality and structure of the room

sentences.en: The concert hall was designed with excellent ______ for orchestral music.
sentences.zh: 這座音樂廳的設計具有絕佳的音響效果,適合演奏管弦樂。

sentences.en: Poor ______ in the gym made the speech hard to hear.
sentences.zh: 這座體育館的音響效果不佳,讓這場演講很難聽清楚。

words.defn_en: bitter, harsh

sentences.en: An ______ smell of smoke filled the air after the fire.
sentences.zh: 火災過後,空氣中瀰漫著一股刺鼻的煙味。

sentences.en: His ______ comments left a bitter taste in everyone's mouth.
sentences.zh: 他刻薄的言論讓每個人心裡都留下了不快的餘味。

words.defn_en: bitter:

sentences.en: The couple went through an ______ divorce that lasted nearly two years.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻經歷了一場長達近兩年、爭執激烈的離婚訴訟。

sentences.en: The meeting became ______ when the two managers began shouting at each other.
sentences.zh: 當兩位經理開始互相大吼時,這場會議變得劍拔弩張。

words.defn_en: bitterness, discord:

sentences.en: The divorce proceedings were marked by great ______ between the couple.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻的離婚訴訟過程充滿了尖刻的敵意。

sentences.en: Years of ______ between the two business partners finally ended their friendship.
sentences.zh: 多年的不和讓這兩位生意夥伴的友誼最終破裂。

words.defn_en: intended for or communicated to an inner circle of disciples; esoteric:
words.defn_zh: 秘傳的;僅限內部傳授的

sentences.en: Aristotle reportedly reserved his most difficult, ______ lectures for advanced students only.
sentences.zh: 據傳亞里斯多德把最艱深、僅限內部傳授的講座,留給程度較高的學生。

sentences.en: The society's ______ teachings were never written down for outsiders to read.
sentences.zh: 這個社團秘傳的教義從未寫下,外人無從得知。

words.defn_en: an extreme or irrational fear of heights:

sentences.en: Her ______ made the glass elevator ride unbearable.
sentences.zh: 她的懼高症讓這趟玻璃電梯之旅變得難以忍受。

sentences.en: He avoided the observation deck entirely because of his ______ .
sentences.zh: 他因為懼高症而完全避開這座觀景台。

words.defn_en: keen insight:

sentences.en: Her sharp business ______ helped the startup succeed within its first year.
sentences.zh: 她敏銳的商業頭腦幫助這家新創公司在第一年就取得了成功。

sentences.en: The detective's investigative ______ allowed him to solve the case quickly.
sentences.zh: 這位偵探敏銳的辦案能力讓他迅速偵破了這起案件。

words.defn_en: sharp, keen, severe:

sentences.en: She felt an ______ pain in her side after the fall.
sentences.zh: 跌倒之後,她感到側腰一陣劇烈的疼痛。

sentences.en: He has an ______ sense of hearing that lets him detect the faintest sounds.
sentences.zh: 他擁有敏銳的聽覺,能夠察覺最細微的聲音。

words.defn_en: a diacritical mark (´) placed over a vowel, as in café:

sentences.en: The word "résumé" is written with two ______ marks in French.
sentences.zh: 法文中 résumé 這個字帶有兩個尖音符號。

sentences.en: She forgot to add the ______ over the e in "café," so the spell-checker flagged it.
sentences.zh: 她忘了在 café 的 e 上方加尖音符號,結果被拼字檢查程式標記出來。

words.defn_en: again and again in the same way; endlessly:

sentences.en: The toddler repeated the same question ______ until his mother finally answered.
sentences.zh: 那個小孩不停重複問同一個問題,直到媽媽終於回答為止。

sentences.en: Mathematicians can, in theory, extend the sequence of numbers ______.
sentences.zh: 理論上,數學家可以將這串數列無限延伸下去。

words.defn_en: a traditional saying expressing a general truth:

sentences.en: Her grandmother had an ______ for every occasion, however small.
sentences.zh: 她的祖母無論遇到什麼場合,都有一句相應的格言。

sentences.en: The old ______ "slow and steady wins the race" proved true once again.
sentences.zh: 「穩紮穩打終能致勝」這句老諺語再次得到印證。

words.defn_en: unyielding, inflexible:

sentences.en: She was ______ that she would not change her mind.
sentences.zh: 她堅決表示絕不會改變主意。

sentences.en: Despite the pressure, he remained ______ in his refusal to sign.
sentences.zh: 儘管承受壓力,他仍堅定不移地拒絕簽署。

words.defn_en: confused; unable to think clearly:

sentences.en: Jet lag left him too ______ to remember which hotel room was his.
sentences.zh: 時差讓他頭昏腦脹,連自己住哪間旅館房間都記不清。

sentences.en: The old professor grew increasingly ______ as the lecture dragged on without notes.
sentences.zh: 隨著講座越拖越長,又沒有講稿可看,這位老教授變得越來越糊塗。

words.defn_en: skillful:

sentences.en: The ______ negotiator managed to satisfy both sides of the dispute.
sentences.zh: 這位機敏的談判者成功讓爭議雙方都感到滿意。

sentences.en: She is remarkably ______ at solving problems under pressure.
sentences.zh: 她在壓力之下解決問題的能力極為熟練。

words.defn_en: to praise or flatter too greatly; fawn over

sentences.en: Fans continued to ______ the singer despite the controversy.
sentences.zh: 儘管爭議不斷,粉絲們依然持續奉承這位歌手。

sentences.en: He hated how his assistant would ______ him in front of others.
sentences.zh: 他很討厭助理在其他人面前對他阿諛奉承的樣子。

words.defn_en: extreme praise:

sentences.en: The pop star basked in the ______ of her adoring fans.
sentences.zh: 這位流行歌手沉浸在崇拜她的粉絲們的讚美之中。

sentences.en: He grew uncomfortable with the constant ______ from his students.
sentences.zh: 他對學生們不斷的過度讚美感到不自在。

words.defn_en: beneficial or useful:

sentences.en: Speaking multiple languages is ______ in today's job market.
sentences.zh: 在當今的就業市場上,會說多種語言是很有利的。

sentences.en: It would be ______ for the company to expand into overseas markets.
sentences.zh: 對這家公司來說,拓展海外市場將會是有利的。

words.defn_en: willing to take risks; adventurous:

sentences.en: Her ______ spirit led her to backpack across six countries alone.
sentences.zh: 她愛冒險的性格讓她獨自背包旅行走遍六個國家。

sentences.en: The menu offers a few ______ dishes for diners willing to try something unusual.
sentences.zh: 菜單上有幾道給願意嘗鮮的饕客準備的冒險料理。

words.defn_en: wordy, padded language, especially the overuse of unnecessary adverbs:
words.defn_zh: 冗詞贅語(尤指濫用副詞)

sentences.en: The editor cut half the manuscript, calling it needless ______.
sentences.zh: 編輯刪掉了手稿的一半,直言那是不必要的冗詞贅語。

sentences.en: His speech, thick with ______ , left the audience unsure of his actual point.
sentences.zh: 他的演講充斥著冗詞贅語,讓聽眾搞不清楚他真正想表達的重點。
